original_test_intent: Validate GPUDirect Storage on the approved storage-to-GPU path and demonstrate controlled GDS throughput exceeds an equivalent non-GDS transfer without data or device damage.
original_method: Pin driver/CUDA/cuFile/GDS/gdsio and wrapper; map NVMe serial/namespace/filesystem, CPU/NUMA/PCIe/GPU/GPM path; allocate a backed-up disposable scratch file, never an unverified raw node; define identical GDS/non-GDS direction/size/block/iterations/duration/cache policy; preserve logs, run monitored paired trials, verify checksums and compare numeric throughput/latency.
manual_activity: Storage/GPU owner selects disposable scratch media, topology, paired comparator and thresholds; operator verifies serial/UUID twice, backups, cooling/OOB and destructive-I/O authorization.
required_inputs: NVMe serial/namespace/filesystem UUID and scratch file
Equivalent GDS/non-GDS parameters and cache policy
Numeric throughput/latency/integrity thresholds and health stops
safety_requirements: Never execute source raw `dd` on an unconfirmed device
Require explicit disposable target and double identity check
Abort on data, storage, PCIe, GPU, thermal or power anomaly
No automatic retry or cleanup of evidence
agent_execution_scope: Create data only in approved scratch filesystem
Run one paired GDS/non-GDS trial set
Perform approved cleanup/recovery and report without verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve malformed source and approve safe target/comparator

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It states the intended benchmark but is non-executable and does not neutralize the destructive raw paths or define the comparator.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the documented gdsio equivalent only on an allowlisted scratch file and a separately approved parameter-matched non-GDS comparator; never copy the raw `dd` step.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: 1G size, 1M I/O, device index 4, write mode, 60-second gdsio phase and GDS-over-non-GDS comparison remain subject to target validation.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run randomized/order-balanced paired trials on one verified scratch path with identical parameters, checksums and synchronized device/GPU telemetry.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces destructive/malformed raw commands with safe file targets and adds topology, comparator, statistics and integrity.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: GDS success alone does not satisfy the required better-than-non-GDS comparison.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong raw target can destroy data; sustained I/O may overheat/wear storage and stress PCIe/GPU paths.

project_override_considerations: Storage/performance engineering must define comparator backend/cache behavior, repetition/statistics and minimum GDS improvement while controlling NUMA and topology effects.
expected_evidence: Package versions and pinned script hash
NVMe serial/namespace/filesystem UUID, backup and scratch proof
Exact paired commands and raw bandwidth/latency samples
